in_sanskrit.name: मिथन्

in_marathi.name: Mithansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun God's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mithra is the Sun God, and Ansh means grace. Mithansh symbolizes receiving the blessings of the Sun God.

in_bengali.name: Mithansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun God's grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mithansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mithra is the Sun God, and Ansh means grace. Mithansh symbolizes receiving the blessings of the Sun God.
